paras.en: When weights (i.e. relative importance of the commodities) are considered in the calculations of index number formulas i.e. both prices and quantities are considered. Such index numbers are called weighted index numbers. They are further divided as weighted aggregative index numbers and weighted average of relatives index numbers.
